Premise: measured 2026-11-17T11:52Z on objectstack-ai/objectstack `origin/main` 3bbda33b, by code reading (the live before-leg for each slice is taken in its own PR). All nine items hold. Causes and the slice 1 route:

**Item 1 (checks only after publish).** A draft read folds only the publish REFUSAL into `_diagnostics`: `draftPublishVerdict` returns `verdict.error.issues` alone (`packages/metadata-protocol/src/protocol-authoring-gate.ts:745`) and `withPublishVerdict` writes them as `errors[]` (`packages/metadata-protocol/src/metadata-diagnostics.ts:428`). The gate's advisories reach the console only on a save or publish 2xx body, where the toast prints them as `[rule] where — text` (`ui/packages/app-shell/src/providers/saveAdvisoryToast.ts:106`). The designer half already exists: it re-reads the draft after every save (`ResourceEditPage.tsx:2058-2064`), maps `_diagnostics.warnings` to Problems rows with node targets (`ResourceEditPage.tsx:922`, `previews/flow-problems.ts:286`), and the Problems tab already carries a count (`previews/FlowPreview.tsx:391`). So the missing half is server-side.

**Item 2 (rule ids, internal names, English).** `flow-decision-unconditional-branch` has no user-text catalog: its findings carry no `userTextParams` (`packages/lint/src/lint-flow-patterns.ts`; the catalogs are listed in `packages/lint/src/finding-user-text.ts:55-74`), so its English `message` is what is shown. `approval-approvers-may-resolve-empty` has a catalog (`validate-approval-approvers.user-text.ts:279`), but it interpolates the flow name and the node id (`validate-approval-approvers.ts:673,720`). That is where `xin_huiyi_tixing` and `node_3` come from.

**Items 3-9.** Item 3: the edge condition is one CEL text box (`inspectors/FlowEdgeInspector.tsx:313`, `engine.inspector.flowEdge.conditionHint`). Item 4: inserting an approval node creates one plain out-edge, and its help text asks the author to label the edges (`metadata-admin/i18n.ts:394`). Item 5: the English labels are at `inspectors/flow-node-config.ts:762,1081,1097,1135,1137`. Items 6, 8 and 9: `engine.flowPreview.noVars`, `engine.studio.draftSaved` and `engine.flowRuns.unavailable` (studio namespace `zh.ts:3609,1981,3621`). Item 7 (the debug panel layout) is measured live in slice 3.

**Route, slice 1 (items 1-2).**
- The draft read also folds the gate's advisories into `_diagnostics.warnings`. Each warning carries the finding's `userMessage` in the request's language when the finding has one, with the locale threaded the way the save door threads `userTextLocalesOf(ctx)`.
- `flow-decision-unconditional-branch` gains a sibling user-text catalog.
- Both flow rules interpolate the node's and the flow's labels, keeping the id where there is no label.
- The publish drawer lists the same warnings, and the post-publish toast keeps only its one title line.
- Rules, severities and verdicts do not change.
- Showing the rule id under "learn more" would need a `code` on `_diagnostics.warnings[]`, and `MetadataValidationResultSchema` carries only `path` and `message` there (`packages/spec/src/kernel/metadata-plugin.zod.ts:545`). It stays out of slice 1 unless the seat wants that spec widening (the card says "可").

Prior rulings read: advisory,usermessage,diagnostics,approval,decision,unconditional,condition,autosave,toast → 82 hits; ADR-0019 D1, ADR-0032 Decision §2, ADR-0044 D2, ADR-0077 Decision §1; thread: none; repo: objectstack-ai/objectstack. Ruling record 6819749037 (option C: the producer of a finding composes its user sentence) sets item 2's route. ADR-0044 D2 makes `revise` a third approval label; slice 2 inserts only approve and reject, as the card asks.

Expected declarations: slice 1 `Clause-②: no` (no new export and no spec key; confirmed at code), slices 2 and 3 `Clause-②: no`, and `Metadata-protocol: none` for all three.

## Claim amendment: slice 3 · 2026-11-17T16:41Z

Amends the #34818 claim for its third and last slice: items 5 to 9, plus the approval help text moved from slice 2. Slice 1 merged (#34850); slice 2 is #34932 (L1-b ACCEPT 6954415659). Slice 3 builds on main after #34932 merges.

### Declarations
- `Clause-②: no`, `Metadata-protocol: none`; changeset `@object-ui/app-shell` + `@object-ui/i18n` patch; `Fixes #34818`.
- Not governed; estimated 900–1300 changed lines. Review: L1-b only, no seat L2 (Clause-② no). If the final file list reaches `packages/spec`, a protocol, an ADR or a governed path, stop and ask the seat.
- New keys go to the lazy `studio` namespace only; no eager pack changes.

### Seat ruling on item 8 (autosave toast vs #28345 ruling 6545938831 ②)
Ruling ② says the Studio top-bar 「已保存」 is **not** write feedback; only feedback that names the record, as a toast or inline, counts. Dropping the flow autosave toast is allowed **only if the replacement is inline record-naming feedback**:
- The 已保存 badge sits in the flow pillar's own header row, beside the flow's title. It must not go in the global Studio top bar.
- Its accessible text names the flow, for example an `aria-live="polite"` announcement 「流程「<label>」已保存」 / `Flow "<label>" saved`. The visible text may stay short (已保存) because the title beside it names the item.
- A refused save keeps the existing refusal strip and raises one error toast, as drafted.
- Leaf, app-nav and object autosaves keep their toast.
- A test pins the badge's placement in the flow header and its record-naming accessible text, with the leaf toast as a control.
If the badge cannot sit in the flow's own header beside its title, keep the toast.

### Setup's flow page
`metadata-admin/ResourceEditPage.tsx` is out of this slice. If coding finds the same Debug squeeze there, ask the seat for a one-line addendum. Don't widen the surface on your own.

### Not in this slice
The node panel's field order, internal names and delete button belong to #34796. `packages/lint` rule text is untouched.

### File surface (slice 3)

All paths are under `ui/packages/app-shell/src/views/` unless the path is given in full.

### Item 5: untranslated words in the node panel, and the approval help text moved from slice 2

| Path | Why |
|---|---|
| `metadata-admin/inspectors/flow-node-config.ts` | **Wording:** the approval `approvers` help drops "label the node's out-edges approve and reject", since slice 2 now inserts them, and says the edges come with the node. **Placeholder overlay:** `localizeFlowFields` learns a field and column `placeholder`, so the prose placeholder `legal / finance — for per-group sign-off` can be translated. Example literals such as cron strings and URLs stay English, as the table's header says. |
| `metadata-admin/i18n.ts` | **`FLOW_FIELD_ZH` rows that are missing:** `decision.mode` (label, help, both options); `approval.approvers.cols.resolveAs` (label, four options); `approval.approvers.cols.group` (placeholder); `approval.onEmptyApprovers` (label, help, three options). **Wording:** the `approvers` help changes to match the English. `minApprovals` help replaces `quorum` and `per_group` with 法定人数 and 分组会签, the words the `behavior` options already use. **Type:** the `FlowFieldZh` type gains `placeholder`. |
| `metadata-admin/inspectors/inspectorStrings.i18n-34818.test.tsx` (new) | Renders the decision and approval inspectors in zh-CN. It asserts every label, help, option and prose placeholder reads its zh row. It also asserts no `quorum`, `per_group` or ASCII sentence is left, with a lit control. |

### Item 6: the Debug tab takes the right column's place

| Path | Why |
|---|---|
| `studio-design/StudioDesignSurface.tsx` (flow pillar) | While the flow's section is `debug`, the Configuration aside is not drawn, in both the classic layout and the right-slot portal. The selection is kept, so leaving Debug brings the aside back as it was. |
| `metadata-admin/previews/FlowPreview.tsx` | The chrome `debug` section widens the simulator column from the fixed 240px to the aside's width. |
| `metadata-admin/previews/FlowSimulatorPanel.tsx` | Only if the toolbar (Run, Step, Continue, Reset and the status pill) still wraps at the new width: it lets the toolbar wrap instead of being clipped. |
| `metadata-admin/previews/FlowPreview.debugTakesAside-34818.test.tsx` (new), or a new describe in an existing StudioDesignSurface flow suite | Pins that the aside is gone while in Debug and back on leaving it, with the selection kept. Includes a control: the Canvas section keeps the aside. |

### Item 7: "Add variable" on the Variables tab

| Path | Why |
|---|---|
| `metadata-admin/previews/FlowVariablesPanel.tsx` (new) | Replaces the read-only `FlowVariablesList`. The empty state says what variables are for: values steps read as `{{ name }}`, inputs a caller passes, outputs the flow returns. **Add variable** appends a uniquely named `text` variable through `onPatch({ variables })`. Each row edits name, type, default, input and output. A name the spec refuses (`$`-led, or a duplicate) is held with a note and not written. Renaming or removing a variable that a node still references is refused with a note naming the steps; references are not rewritten in this card. |
| `metadata-admin/previews/FlowPreview.tsx` | Mounts the panel in both the chrome `variables` section and the classic side panel. Passes `onPatch` and the `readOnly` / `editable` state, so a read-only package keeps a list with no add button. |
| `metadata-admin/previews/FlowVariablesPanel-34818.test.tsx` (new) | Covers the add, edit, refusal and reference-guard cases, the read-only control, and what the patch writes, parsed with the spec's `FlowVariableSchema`. |

### Item 8: autosave says "已保存" in the header, not in a toast

| Path | Why |
|---|---|
| `studio-design/StudioDesignSurface.tsx` (flow pillar) | **Stop the toast:** a landed flow draft autosave no longer calls `announceDraftSaved`. **Badge:** the header's action row already shows the 正在保存 spinner (`auto-autosaving`). It now settles into 已保存 (`auto-autosaved`), which stays until the next edit. **Failure:** the existing refusal strip stays, and a failed save also raises one error toast. |
| `studio-design/StudioPillarKit.tsx` | Comment only: `announceDraftSaved`'s header no longer lists the flow pillar. Its other callers (leaf, app nav, object) are unchanged. |
| A new describe in the existing flow-autosave Studio suite, or `StudioDesignSurface.flowAutosaveBadge-34818.test.tsx` (new) | Pins that a landed save shows 已保存 and raises no toast, and that a refused save shows the strip and an error toast. Controls: a leaf autosave still toasts, and a second edit clears 已保存. |


### Item 9: the Runs tab says why it is empty

| Path | Why |
|---|---|
| `metadata-admin/previews/FlowRunsPanel.tsx` | Takes a `published` flag. With no published version, the panel shows 发布并启用后，这里显示每次运行的记录 and does not fetch. With a published flow whose fetch fails, the engine-offline sentence shows alone. |
